name: tactiq
description: TactIQ — AI tactical advisor and training-session designer for youth soccer coaches

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.check:formations: esbuild client/src/formations.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=checks/formations.bundle.mjs && node checks/check-geometry.mjs && node checks/validate-principles.mjs
